deliveries.text: The blockchain.

deliveries.text: The BLOCKCHAIN.

deliveries.text: A public ledger.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: It records what moved, when it moved...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: Once recorded, those entries cannot simply be erased.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX

deliveries.text: Token quantity is not value.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: But there are nine whole digits.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: And not one of them tells you what a single token is worth.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: I don’t believe you.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: You don’t have to. Use Token God Mode on the Nansen™ terminal.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: Check the price, the liquidity, who’s buying and selling...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: and whether any real value is flowing in or out.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Or confirm that I’m independently wealthy.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: I wouldn’t hold your breath on that.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Fine. I’ll check it myself.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: Well?

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: At the frozen quoted price: 888,888,888 BRCG comes to about...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: That’s some ‘fortune’ you got there!

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: And the note still does not prove that the balance exists...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: belongs to you... or could even be sold for that amount.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: So I shattered a pig for seven hypothetical dollars.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: And a useful lesson.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Can the lesson pay for a new pig?

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: It cannot.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Mr. A!

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: What now?

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: I cracked the case!

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: You identified who did it?

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Well, no...

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: BUT, I traced the wallet movements and the transactions connecting them.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Whoever was behind the wallets is still unknown.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Could be one person. Could be several.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Could be the same dog that ate that ransomware gang’s decryption key.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: The dog is not a suspect.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Breed still unknown and at large.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: Then what did you find?

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: The route. I traced it all. The first DAI trail reached the First Engine...

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: the second route reached the Receiving Vault... and best of all...

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: I found the exact transaction that connected them.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: Good. So you did your job. Barely.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: And arguably, Nansen™ did most of the heavy lifting.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: I asked the right question.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: And let the evidence answer it.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: Considering that this morning you did not know what a blockchain was...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: that is progress.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: That sounded dangerously close to praise.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: It was an observation.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: I’ll take it.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: So... now that I cracked the case, can I call you Arthur?

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: You may not.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: But your friends call you Arthur, and we made a pretty good team today.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: You completed one assignment. That barely establishes competence...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: let alone friendship.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: So friendship is still under review?

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: It never entered review.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: How about a celebratory pizza, then?

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: This is still not a pizza restaurant.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: But...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: there is a place around the corner.

deliveries.text: I knew you’d warm up to me.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: We just happen to both be hungry at the same time.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: That’s how the best of teams start!

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: No. It really isn’t.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: So you’re buying?

deliveries.text: Same terminal. Better question.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Wow. This spins so easily! Barely any friction at all.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Now it’s picking up some real speed.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Wheeeeeeee!

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: I think that’s as fast as it’ll go!

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: And now... the other way.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: No better way to set the mood than dimming the lights.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Though... I don’t want Mr. A to get the wrong idea.

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: Cozy.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: You broke my pen. I’d say you owe me.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: You broke my pen. I’d say you owe me.

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: And besides, you’re rolling in the dough now...

deliveries.speaker: MR_INDEX
deliveries.text: with all that BRCG you somehow came across. Right?

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: That’s right! That should cover one slice...

deliveries.speaker: ROOK
deliveries.text: to share.

deliveries.text: This one’s on me!
